name: SM Alt Text Image Creator
author: Sumit Malviya

sections.description:
SM Alt Text Image Creator automatically detects images without ALT attributes and generates meaningful ALT text from the image filename.

Example:

Image URL:

red-hibiscus-closeup.webp

Generated ALT:

Red Hibiscus Closeup

Works with:

  • Gutenberg
  • Classic Editor
  • Elementor
  • WooCommerce
  • Most WordPress themes
  • Most page builders

Features

  • Automatically generate ALT text
  • Enable / Disable from settings
  • SEO friendly
  • Accessibility friendly
  • Lightweight
  • No third-party APIs
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files.
  2. Activate plugin.
  3. Navigate to Settings > SM Alt Text Image Creator.
  4. Enable Auto Alt Text.
  5. Save settings.
sections.faq:
Does it overwrite existing ALT text?

No. Existing ALT text is never modified.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes.
